meta.ogTitle: Founding Member survey: help shape Puntr

lead: A few quick questions, one at a time. Your answers decide what we build first before launch on 1 December 2026.
signIn: Sign in or join free to take the Founding Member survey.

doneDraw: You are entered into the draw.

q1: How would you rate Puntr so far?
q4: Which of these would you use most? (pick any)
q5: What do you think of the planned pricing?

contact: You may contact me about my feedback (optional)
rules: One entry per member. 18+ only. Entering the draw is optional and does not change your Puntr account. Full draw rules, the closing date and how the winner is chosen and told will be published on this page. T&Cs apply.
privacy: We use your answers to improve Puntr. Read how we handle your data in our Privacy Policy.

upsell.title: The Founding Member Annual Pass
upsell.body: 12 months of Puntr Pro for a once-off R299, instead of R1,188 on R99 a month. You save R889. Your 12 months start on launch day, 1 December 2026, and it does not renew automatically.
upsell.note: A prepaid membership, not an investment. Claiming includes payment of R299 once-off through PayFast, for the first 20 founding members before 16 November 2026.
